supervisory_authorities.dpa: Office of the Australian Information Commissioner (OAIC)

statutory_frameworks.official_title: Security of Critical Infrastructure Act 2018 as amended by SOCI Reforms 2021-2024
statutory_frameworks.supervisory_authority: Cyber and Infrastructure Security Centre (CISC / Department of Home Affairs) / ACSC

metadata.mandate: Part 2A mandates Critical Infrastructure Risk Management Program (CIRMP) Section 30AC/30AD; Part 2B mandatory cyber incident reporting.

statutory_frameworks.official_title: Privacy Act 1988 as amended by Privacy Legislation Amendment (Enforcement and Other Measures) Act
statutory_frameworks.supervisory_authority: Office of the Australian Information Commissioner (OAIC)

metadata.notifiable_data_breaches: Part IIIC Notifiable Data Breaches (NDB) scheme

cyber_security_mandates.target_domain: Critical Infrastructure Assets (11 Sectors / 22 Asset Classes)
cyber_security_mandates.baseline_standard_ref: Essential Eight Maturity Model / ISO/IEC 27001 / IEC 62443 / NIST CSF
cyber_security_mandates.mandatory_certifications: CIRMP Annual Board Attestation under Section 30AG; ACSC System of National Significance (SoNS) Enhanced Cybersecurity Obligations
cyber_security_mandates.details: Australian entities responsible for critical infrastructure must enforce application control, patch applications within 48 hours for extreme risk vulnerabilities (Essential Eight Level 3), and submit annual board-approved compliance reports.

data_privacy_sovereignty.primary_privacy_law: Data Protection and Privacy Act of Australia
data_privacy_sovereignty.supervisory_dpa: Office of the Australian Information Commissioner (OAIC)
data_privacy_sovereignty.localization_scope: Sector-specific financial and government data localization where applicable.

cryptography_controls.crypto_export_controls: National Customs & Dual-Use Export Control Regime.
cryptography_controls.post_quantum_mandate: Monitoring international standard bodies (ISO/IEC JTC 1 / ITU-T).

incident_disclosure_rules.threshold_trigger_definition: SOCI Act Section 30BC: Incident that has a significant impact on the availability, integrity, or reliability of the asset must be reported within 12 hours.
SOCI Act Section 30BD: Incident that has a relevant impact on the asset.

sector_applicability.specific_obligations: Generation, transmission, distribution, and pipeline SCADA integrity.
Water treatment, distribution telemetry, and environmental control.
Hospital systems, medical device cybersecurity, and EHR data protection.
Payment systems, banking core networks, and cyber resilience audits.
Public telecommunications networks, submarine cables, and 5G security.
Machinery safety, industrial robotics, PLC programming, and safety instrumented systems.
Rail signaling, air traffic management, maritime port terminals, and connected vehicles.
